body.text: President Donald J. Trump participates in a trilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at Kylin Villa in Shenzhen, China, Nov. 19, 2026.

In this episode of The Diplomat’s Asia Geopolitics Podcast, hosts Ankit Panda and Katie Putz discuss the recent trilateral meeting in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC Summit between the leaders of the U.S., Russia, and China, analyzing the optics and the results of the talks. They also touch on the brief Quad leaders meeting that took place in Manila.
Ankit Panda is editor-at-large at The Diplomat and the Stanton Senior Fellow in the Nuclear Policy Program at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace. Follow him on Twitter .
Catherine Putz is managing editor of The Diplomat.
